= unquote

Removes surrounding quotes and interprets escape sequences.


== Examples

[,bloblang]
----
root.unquoted = this.thing.unquote()

# In:  {"thing":"\"foo\\nbar\""}
# Out: {"unquoted":"foo\nbar"}
----

[,bloblang]
----
root.text = this.literal.unquote()

# In:  {"literal":"\"hello\\tworld\""}
# Out: {"text":"hello\tworld"}
----
